limitations: The reviewed 2,416-passage historical reference corpus is bound by its saved manifest and source hashes. Fresh full-reference replay uses the current 2,000-passage selection; historical reference inventory identities behind the three-reference difference remain unverified.

The two split-only tool-agent adjudications expose declared filesRead records rather than raw tool traces. Direct JSON scopes, decisions, and applied labels are verified; actual adjudicator reads remain unverified.
CLI log checks inspect captured shell command blocks and literal file paths. Dynamic or uncaptured access is outside this mechanical check. Relative literals are retained for inspection.
No second reviewer was used, as requested. This audit checks numeric and procedural properties and supplies no semantic judgments.

selectedScreen.method: Lowercase Unicode tokens; normalized exact equality, or >=10 shared five-word shingles and Jaccard>=0.2 or shorter containment>=0.5; under20-token fallback uses token Levenshtein<=25% longer, allowing one edit under4. All new pairs, within and across splits; each new passage against ALL prior dataset splits, full texts, legacy fixture paragraphs/full files, and literal definition examples.

copyAudit.replayTokenizer: Lowercase Unicode letters/numbers, preserving internal straight and curly apostrophes.

selectedSerializationComparison.operation: Compare unordered passage-ID pairs, normalize endpoint orientation, sort pair records, then compare endpoint metadata and every metric.

preliminaryReplayCorrection.conclusion: The initial audit tokenizer split internal apostrophes and raised one pair above the 0.2 Jaccard threshold. The corrected tokenizer reproduces all 212 reviewed candidate pairs and 139 selected candidate pairs.
